+"""R8 machinery regression suite for alpha_ledger (generated by asset worker)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from alpha_ledger.store import ConflictError, EventStore, IntegrityError
+
+
+def _store(tmp_path: Path) -> EventStore:
+    return EventStore(tmp_path / "events.jsonl")
+
+
+def test_empty_store_verifies(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = _store(tmp_path)
+    store.verify()
+    assert store.event_count() == 0
+
+
+def test_append_returns_increasing_sequences(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = _store(tmp_path)
+    first = store.append({"kind": "a", "value": 1}, idempotency_key="k1")
+    second = store.append({"kind": "b", "value": 2}, idempotency_key="k2")
+    assert second == first + 1
+
+
+def test_append_is_idempotent_by_key(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = _store(tmp_path)
+    store.append({"kind": "a"}, idempotency_key="same")
+    count = store.event_count()
+    store.append({"kind": "a"}, idempotency_key="same")
+    assert store.event_count() == count
+
+
+def test_conflicting_key_raises(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = _store(tmp_path)
+    store.append({"kind": "a"}, idempotency_key="same")
+    with pytest.raises(ConflictError):
+        store.append({"kind": "b"}, idempotency_key="same")
+
+
+def test_tampered_payload_raises(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = _store(tmp_path)
+    store.append({"kind": "a", "value": "original"}, idempotency_key="k1")
+    raw_path = tmp_path / "events.jsonl"
+    lines = raw_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
+    tampered = lines[0].replace("original", "TAMPERED")
+    raw_path.write_text(tampered + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
+        store.verify()
+
+
+def test_malformed_line_raises(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = _store(tmp_path)
+    store.append({"kind": "a"}, idempotency_key="k1")
+    raw_path = tmp_path / "events.jsonl"
+    raw_path.write_text(raw_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") + "not-json\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
+        store.verify()
+
+
+def test_state_hash_changes_on_append(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = _store(tmp_path)
+    before = store.state_hash()
+    store.append({"kind": "a"}, idempotency_key="k1")
+    assert store.state_hash() != before
+
+
+def test_read_returns_payloads_in_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    store = _store(tmp_path)
+    store.append({"kind": "a"}, idempotency_key="k1")
+    store.append({"kind": "b"}, idempotency_key="k2")
+    assert [record["kind"] for record in store.read()] == ["a", "b"]
